# Third-party files

| file | source | licence | use here |
|---|---|---|---|
| `STS3215_03a.step` | Feetech STS3215 servo model from the SO-ARM100 project, https://github.com/TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 | Apache License 2.0 (`SO-ARM100_LICENSE`) | reference solid for servo clearances and renders only.
